summary: Zoomcar Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the fifth closing of a private placement of Series A units at $1,000 per unit, each comprising one Series A convertible preferred share (stated value $1,000) and one warrant for 20,000 common shares. The August 31 and September 4, 2026 closings raised roughly $80,000 via 80 units — 20 for cash and 60 settled against accrued obligations — under Rule 506(c), part of a $5,000,000 offering (plus $5,000,000 overallotment) terminating September 4, 2026. The micro-sized raise and non-cash component make this a financing event rather than a conventional capital return.
